entities.title: Dimension (check)
entities.summary: One of the seven areas the tool judges separately: local network, public internet, VPN connection, routing, corporate DNS, corporate service, proxy. Each gets one state.
notToBeConfusedWith: Finding: a problem found within a dimension, with its remedy.

entities.title: Finding
entities.summary: One diagnosed problem: a code, a one-line summary and a remedy.

entities.title: Outcome (remedy)
entities.summary: What it takes to resolve a finding: fixable (repair steps), not fixable by this tool (manual advice) or reboot needed.

entities.title: Gate
entities.summary: A flag a repair step needs before fix may run it: --vpn, --fix-proxy, --allow-route-flush, or --allow-remote for disruptive steps over SSH.

entities.title: Disruptive step
entities.summary: A repair step that can cut an SSH or VPN session: VPN reconnect, DHCP renew, Wi-Fi cycle, route flush.

entities.title: scutil-managed VPN
entities.summary: A VPN service listed by scutil --nc list, whose state the tool can read and which it can stop and start.
notToBeConfusedWith: Tunnel: any utun, ipsec, ppp, tun, tap or wg interface carrying routes, which may belong to a client scutil does not manage.

entities.title: Tunnel
entities.summary: An interface whose name starts with utun, ipsec, ppp, tun, tap or wg and that carries non-link-local routes (a scoped default route does not count).

entities.title: Full tunnel / split tunnel
entities.summary: Full tunnel: the route to the public probe address goes into a tunnel. Split tunnel: a tunnel carries routes but public traffic does not use it.

entities.title: Split-DNS resolver
entities.summary: A resolver from scutil --dns for one domain, with nameservers, not scoped and not for .arpa or local; the most specific one answers for an internal host.

entities.title: Stale
entities.summary: Left behind by a VPN or network that is gone: a route on an interface that is no longer up, a split-DNS resolver whose interface is gone or whose server is unreachable, or a VPN that reports Connected on an interface that no longer exists.

entities.title: Internal host
entities.summary: A corporate name or address, optionally with a port, given with --internal-host to check corporate DNS, routing through the tunnel and TCP.
